title: The Edited stamp wording, and a plain @ left in the message text
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell icon at the top right (it opens on the Inbox tab).
  3. Seed three notifications addressed to you - a second user writes the notes (on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView")): open a work order (top menu Work Orders -> click a work order number (e.g. S2-4219) -> Notes tab) -> New Note, type a message, type @ and pick "Admin ShopView" (or click a tag group pill you belong to under "Tag groups:"), then click Save - one whose note has been edited (as its author, the note's menu ( ... ) -> Edit), one that has never been edited, and one whose message contains a plain "@" that is not a tag (e.g. "@ me if urgent").
custom_steps:
1. On the Notifications page (click the bell icon at the top right; it opens on the Inbox tab), read the edited stamp on the edited note.
  2. Look for an edited stamp on the never-edited note.
  3. Read the message containing the plain "@".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The "edited" stamp reads "Edited on <date>" (date like "Sep 8, 2026") and does not name the editor (only the author can edit, and they are already named).
  • The "edited" stamp is not shown on a note that has never been edited.
  • A plain "@" that is not a recipient tag (e.g. "@ me if urgent") is left in the message text.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R13: “The "edited" stamp reads "Edited on <date>", where the date is written like "Sep 8, 2026". It does not name the editor, because only the author can edit a note and the author is already named on the notification.”
  • S2-N4: “The "edited" stamp is not shown on a note that has never been edited.”
  • S2-N3: “A plain "@" in the message that is not a recipient tag (for example, "@ me if urgent") is left in the message text.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
